brv_wh_delivery_wyre.m: Yes, I'm longing for it just like how I'm longing for my son. But now I can mourn as I play his favorite song until I die.
r: My sincere condolence for the loss of your beloved son.

brv_wh_delivery_wyre_negative.m: That's not what I'm waiting for! Go out and find out what happened to my son, please!

r: Excuse me, I'm here to deliver your order for a 'Lyre'.

wrye_mourn_2.m: My son! My son is gone.
r: Jolnor said I should see you about your son.
Maybe your order here will comfort you?

wrye_mourn_3.m: I don't want to talk about it. Not with an outsider like you.
r: Jolnor said I should see you about your son.

wrye_mourn_4.m:
Please leave me.

Oh Shadow, watch over me.

wrye_mourn_5.m: My son is dead, I know it! And it's those damn guards fault. Those guards with their snobby Feygard attitude.

wrye_mourn_6.m: At first they come with promises of protection and power. But then you really start to see them for what they are.

wrye_mourn_7.m: I can feel it in me. The Shadow speaks to me. He is dead.
r: Can you tell me what happened?

wrye_mourn_8.m: Thank you. Shadow watch over me.

wrye_resolved_1.m: Please tell me what happened to him!
r: He left Vilegard by his own will because he wanted to see the great city of Feygard.

wrye_resolved_10.m: Thank you, friend, for finding out what happened to him and telling me the truth.

r: He had secretly longed to go to Feygard, but didn't dare tell you.
But he never got far. He was attacked while camping one night.
Yes, he could not stand up to the monsters, and was critically wounded.
I talked to a man that found him bleeding to death.
Yes, but not for long. He did not survive the wounds. He is now buried to the northwest of Vilegard.

wrye_resolved_7.m: Oh my poor boy. What have I done?

wrye_resolved_8.m: I always thought he shared my view of those Feygard snobs.

wrye_resolved_9.m: And now he is not with us anymore.

wrye_return_1.m: Welcome back. Have you found out anything about my son, Rincel?
r: Can you tell me the story about what happened again?
No, I have not found anything yet.
Yes, I have found out the story about what happened to him.
Not yet, but your order has finally arrived.

wrye_return_2.m: Welcome back. Thank you for your help in finding out what happened to my son.
r: Yes, I came back to deliver your order of a 'Lyre'. You must be good at playing it?

wrye_story_1.m: It all started with those Feygard royal guards coming here.

wrye_story_10.m: I fear he has died or got hurt somehow. Those bastards probably drove him into his own death.

r: What can I do to help?
That sounds awful. I am sure you are just imagining things.
Do you have proof that the people from Feygard are involved?

wrye_story_12.m: No, but I know it in me that they are. The Shadow speaks to me.
r: OK. Is there anything I can do to help?
You sound a bit too occupied with the Shadow. I want no part of this.
I probably shouldn't get involved in this if it means that I could upset the royal guard.

wrye_story_13.m: If you want to help me, please find out what happened to my son, Rincel.
r: Any idea where I should look?
OK. I will go look for your son. I sure hope there will be some reward for this.
By the Shadow, your son will be avenged.

wrye_story_14.m: Please return here as soon as you have found out anything.

wrye_story_16.m: I guess you could ask in the tavern here in Vilegard, or the Foaming Flask tavern just north of here.
r: By the Shadow, your son will be avenged.
OK. I will go look for your son. I sure hope there will be some reward for this.
OK. I will go look for your son so that you may know what happened to him.

wrye_story_2.m: They tried to pressure everyone in Vilegard into recruiting more soldiers.

wrye_story_3.m: The guards would say they needed more support to help squelch the supposed uprising and sabotage.
r: How did this relate to your son?
Are you going to get to the point soon?

wrye_story_4.m: My son, Rincel, did not seem to care much for the stories they told.

wrye_story_5.m: I also told Rincel of how bad an idea I thought it was to recruit more people to the Royal Guard.

wrye_story_6.m: The guards stayed a couple of days to talk to everyone here in Vilegard. Then they left. They went to the next town I guess.

wrye_story_7.m: A few days passed, and then suddenly my boy Rincel was gone one day. I am sure those guards managed to somehow persuade him to join them.

wrye_story_8.m: Oh how I despise those evil and snobby Feygard bastards.

wrye_story_9.m: This was several weeks ago. Now I feel an emptiness inside. I know in me that something has happened to my son Rincel.

wrye.10: Jolnor in Vilegard chapel wants me to talk to Wrye in northern Vilegard. She has apparently lost her son recently.
wrye.20: Wrye in northern Vilegard tells me that her son Rincel has gone missing. She thinks that he has died or gotten critically hurt.
wrye.30: Wrye tells me that she thinks the royal guard from Feygard are involved in his disappearance, and that they have recruited him.
wrye.40: Wrye wants me to go search for clues as to what has happened to her son.
wrye.41: I should go look in the Vilegard tavern and the Foaming Flask tavern north of Vilegard.
wrye.42: I heard of a boy being in the Foaming Flask tavern a while ago. Apparently he left to the west of the tavern somewhere.
wrye.80: To the northwest of Vilegard I found a man that had found Rincel fighting some monsters. Rincel had apparently left Vilegard by his own will to go see the city of Feygard. I should go tell Wrye in northern Vilegard what happened to her son.
wrye.90: I have told Wrye the truth about her son's disappearance.

brv_wh_delivery.10: Facutloni asked me to help him deliver all of the items ordered by his customers a long time ago. He even gave me an old document with the names and items written on it.
brv_wh_delivery.20: Arcir the Fallhaven book-lover ordered a 'Dusty Old book'.
brv_wh_delivery.30: Edrin the Brimhaven metalsmith ordered a 'Striped Hammer'.
brv_wh_delivery.40: Odirath the Stoutford armorer ordered a 'Pretty Porcelain Figure'.
brv_wh_delivery.50: Venanra the Brimhaven laundress ordered an 'Old, worn cape'.
brv_wh_delivery.60: Tjure the unlucky Brimhaven merchant ordered a 'Mysterious green something'.
brv_wh_delivery.70: Servant the Guynmart servant ordered a 'Chandelier'.
brv_wh_delivery.80: Arghes at Remgard tavern ordered 'Yellow boots'.
brv_wh_delivery.90: Wyre the mournful Vilegard woman ordered a 'Lyre'.
brv_wh_delivery.110: Pangitain the Brimhaven fortune teller ordered a 'Crystal Globe'.
brv_wh_delivery.120: Facutloni wants me to report back after the deliveries are complete.
brv_wh_delivery.130: I reported back to Facutloni. He is very happy.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
